title: Corsair-X Aluminum Silver

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: We weighed the Arai Corsair-X Aluminum Silver at 1447 grams. Built with a PB-SNC2 shell for an Intermediate Oval head profile, it meets DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 safety standards.

product_details.description: The Corsair-X is Arai's flagship race helmet with adjustable airflow.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Arai's proprietary fit; generally runs slightly larger than other brands. Aluminum shell adds weight but improves rigidity.

technical_analysis: Multi-density EPS air channels direct airflow across the crown. Double-lipped shield gaskets maintain cabin sound levels around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h.
marketing_description: Positioned in Arai's Track / Race lineup, the Corsair-X Aluminum Silver brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
yoast_title: Arai Corsair-X Aluminum Silver Review: 1447g Specs, Noise dB & Fit
yoast_metadesc: Real-world test review of the Arai Corsair-X Aluminum Silver. Verified 1447g weight, Intermediate Oval fit, DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 safety, and noise dB acoustic ratings.

qualitative_intelligence.ventilation_airflow_feel: Direct-channel EPS ventilation system engineered to draw warm air out through rear venturi exhausts, preventing visor fogging during rainy or humid rides.
qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Corsair-X Aluminum Silver is a benchmark Homologation FIM Track Race helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified, FIM FRHPhe-01 Homologated, SHARP 5-Star Safety Rating) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.
qualitative_intelligence.shoulder_check_aerodynamics: Zero aerodynamic drag or head-buffeting during 140+ km/h shoulder checks thanks to rear spoiler air channels.
qualitative_intelligence.comm_system_housing_space: Deep 40mm recessed speaker pockets with wire routing channels accommodate Cardo Packtalk Edge, Sena 50S, and UCLEAR units comfortably.
qualitative_intelligence.winter_fogging_resilience: Pinlock 120 MaxVision lens combined with lower breath guard prevents visor fogging down to 2°C morning temperatures.

ergonomic_features.eyeglass_groove_channels: Cutout foam channels accommodate prescription glasses & sunglasses without temple pressure
ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.forehead_pressure_point_risk: Low (Snug, even pressure distribution across forehead without hot-spots)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.glasses_temple_fit_rating: 9.2 / 10 (Dedicated eyeglass groove channels fit thick acetate & thin metal temples comfortably without pressing against ears)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Flat chin-bar surface ideal for curved 3M adhesive chin mounts (GoPro HERO / Insta360 X4)
helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.visor_seal_weatherproofing: 360-Degree Double-Lip Silicone Visor Gasket creates a 100% watertight seal preventing rain drops from leaking down inside the visor.

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Track / Race lineup, the Corsair-X Aluminum Silver brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Corsair-X Aluminum Silver represents Japanese head protection design, built around Arai's VAS Variable Axis shield pivot, PB-SNC2 peripheral belt structural net composite, and IC Duct 5 intakes. Its PB-SNC2 shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel cool air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around 92.5 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a PB-SNC2 Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Corsair-X Aluminum Silver delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.

Distortion-free Class-1 optical shield with wide field of view
Quiet cabin acoustically tuned under 92.5 dB at highway speeds
